# LootLens

LootLens is a free, mobile-first webapp that exposes retail marketing gimmicks and tells shoppers the best price per unit. Zero-dependency vanilla JavaScript, no build step, no login required.

## What it does
- Compare grocery pack sizes and find the real best deal per gram/ml/piece
- Verify if discount labels are honest (Claim Check)
- Decode "extra free" labels to find the real discount (Extra Free Check)
- Detect shrinkflation — quiet pack size reductions (Shrinkflation Check)
- Check if bundle/combo deals actually save money (Bundle Trap Check)

## Key facts
- Runs entirely in the browser — no data leaves your device
- Supports 20 currencies worldwide
- Free forever, no account needed
- Ad-supported to stay free

## Pages
- [Compare Prices](https://lootlens.antideploy.com/) — Main tool, add 2-8 packs and compare
- [Claim Check Guide](https://lootlens.antideploy.com/guide-claim-check.html) — How to verify discount labels
- [Extra Free Guide](https://lootlens.antideploy.com/guide-extra-free.html) — Decode "extra free" offers
- [Shrinkflation Guide](https://lootlens.antideploy.com/guide-shrinkflation.html) — Detect hidden price hikes
- [Bundle Trap Guide](https://lootlens.antideploy.com/guide-bundle-trap.html) — Check combo deals
- [Privacy Policy](https://lootlens.antideploy.com/privacy.html) — How ads affect your data
